description: This file defines the DrupalMediaEditing plugin class for CKEditor 5, handling media transformation, schema, conversion, and preview fetching specific to Drupal media integration.

classes.name: DrupalMediaEditing
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class for managing Drupal media elements, including schema definition, conversion, and preview handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up schema, converters, listeners, and commands based on configuration.

methods.name: upcastDrupalMediaIsImage
methods.description: Upcasts the 'drupalMediaIsImage' attribute from Drupal media metadata.

methods.name: upcastDrupalMediaType
methods.description: Upcasts the 'drupalMediaType' attribute from Drupal media metadata.

methods.name: _fetchPreview
methods.description: Fetches media preview HTML from the server asynchronously.

methods.name: _defineSchema
methods.description: Defines the schema for 'drupalMedia' element in CKEditor model.

methods.name: _defineConverters
methods.description: Sets up conversion rules for upcast, downcast, and attribute handling.

methods.name: _defineListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for content insertion to update media attributes.

methods.name: _renderElement
methods.description: Renders the 'drupalMedia' element into an HTML string for preview.
